title: Author
description: Author profile with biography, publication statistics, genres, ratings, and verification status. Used for book databases, publishing platforms, and literary management systems.

photo.description: URL to the author's photo or portrait

website.description: Author's personal or professional website URL

books_count.description: Total number of books published by this author

articles_count.description: Total number of articles written by this author

genres.description: Array of genres the author writes in (e.g., Fiction, Non-Fiction, Mystery)

rating.description: Average reader rating of the author's works, typically on a scale of 1-5

verified.description: Whether the author account is verified as authentic
